page_title: WOL 2-3 STU | Wolfsburg v Stuttgart 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' The game has come to an end for Angelo Stiller. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart).
90+7' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is able to continue to play.
90+6' The game is interrupted now, Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+4' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
90+4' The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.

90+4' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Wolfsburg get a corner.
90+3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+3' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) and Maximilian Arnold perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
87' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Serhou Guirassy.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Silas (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Maximilian Mittelstadt.
85' Referee Benjamin Brand signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Wolfsburg players have a reason to celebrate!
84' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Wolfsburg goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
83' It's a yellow card for Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart).
83' 2 - 3 Goal! Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:3.
82' Wolfsburg are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
81' Here is a change. Yannick Gerhardt is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).
81' The referee signals a substitution. Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Kevin Paredes.

78' 1 - 3 Goal! Great play by Jamie Leweling releases Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:3.
77' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
76' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
73' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
73' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is replacing Enzo Millot.
71' Chris Fuhrich will be replaced by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
68' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' Here comes a substitution. Kevin Behrens is given a rest as he is replaced by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
64' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Lovro Majer will be replaced by Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg).
63' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
63' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
58' The goal by Stuttgart won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
57' Wait! Referee Benjamin Brand has indicated he is going to review the Stuttgart goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
56' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
54' 1 - 2 Goal! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Koen Casteels.
54' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
52' Yellow card. Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

52' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Stuttgart are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
51' Referee Benjamin Brand points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Wolfsburg players celebrate.
51' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Wolfsburg players aren’t happy.
50' 1 - 1 Goal! Lovro Majer produces a great pass that finds Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the top right corner. 1:1.
48' Poor challenge! Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is penalised for tripping and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle.
46' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
46' Half-time substitution. Niko Kovac decided to make a change. Vaclav Cerny is replaced by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
43' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and signals a foul after Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) brought his opponent down.
42' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) and Enzo Millot matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
41' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
40' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
37' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
35' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Wolfsburg.
32' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) swings it in and Kevin Behrens gets on the end of it, but Alexander Nubel shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
30' The shots on goal statistics – 0:1.
28' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) tries to find Vaclav Cerny with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
25' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
24' It seemed like Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
22' What was Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
21' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle after Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
20' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
16' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Wolfsburg out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) makes the score 0:1 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Maximilian Mittelstadt.
11' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
9' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
9' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' The foul by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) was seen by Benjamin Brand who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
5' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
2' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Stuttgart will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Benjamin Brand.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
